description: Wever Watch: list the calling wallet’s watches with state (pending_activation, active, fired, expired or cancelled), checks run, last observation and fire count. Optional state filter. POST /api/watch-list. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Every call carries X-Wever-Wallet-Proof bound to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route; a paid call adds Payment-Signature from the same wallet. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/watch-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/watch/.
name: wever_watch-list
title: List watches
